semantics.definition: The rules every Eidos time in seconds must meet.
semantics.responsibility: Time what happens in the 3D world, in seconds. A control's motion is a duration, 50 to 300 ms, not a time.

s.description: How long something in the 3D world takes, or how often it comes, in seconds, to the hundredth: more than 0, at most 600.
